messages:
maya: Quick idea 1 1: Launch a micro refapp playbook + 30min webinar to drive starter repo adoption and collect demo leads. Goals: 700 repo stars, 100 registrants, 20 demo requests.
amanda: Assets: launch blog, repo with clear prework, 3 social GIFs, webinar landing + 3-email cadence. I can own GIFs + emails.
jason: I'll add a tiny perf helper and README snippet to measure p95/p99 and token cost. Example: `python perf.py --prompt \"hi\" --model rdx-small-q4`
li: I'll draft two benchmark bullets (chat vs embeddings) and a single chart for the blog. Keep messaging dev-first and measurable.
sam: SDR ask: add a checkbox "Interested in dedicated capacity trial" and a company size field on the form so we can route. Also add utm_source param.
bot-campaigns: campaign created: micro-refapp-playbook, draft landing: https://redwood.example/micro-playbook (owner: maya)
maya: Nice. Action items: maya -> blog + landing copy (Wed), amanda -> GIFs + emails (Thu), jason -> perf script + README (Wed), li -> benchmark bullets + chart (Thu), sam -> lead form field + utm (Thu). Dry run Fri 9am PT. Keep updates in thread.
